idānīṃ padmākṣakośaṃ trijagaditi vivekodaye trailokyaiśvaryasyāpyalpatvaṃ
yaduktaṃ tadupapādanāya balyākhyānaṃ vaktukāmo vasiṣṭho bhūmikāṃ racayati
- athaveti

prāptavyamakhilaṃ sarvātmakaṃ brahma hṛdi prāptaṃ tasminnevāmale pade
viśrāntaṃ ca

adabhramanalpaṃ tṛṣṇākhyaṃ tatprasiddhaṃ mahātamo mama cetasaḥ
sakāśādapagatam
amṛtāpūrita ityādiviśeṣaṇāni svasya uḍurājasya ca sādhāraṇāni

aśeṣāṇāṃ saṃśayalakṣaṇānāmambhodānāṃ śaratsamaya iva nivāraka iti
gurusaṃbodhanam

vadatastava eṣāṃ vacasāṃ śravaṇaviṣaye tṛptiṃ
alaṃbuddhiṃ na gacchāmi

avanataṃ praṇāmopanataṃ śiṣyaṃ prati
upadeśane iti śeṣaḥ

dehādribhirvalitaṃ vyāptamaśeṣaṃ jagadyeṣāṃ tathāvidhairviśvoddharaṇasya
dharmasya yajñahaviṣo vā ghasmarairbalādbhakṣakaiḥ

kumbhalakṣaṇānāṃ kūṭānāṃ śikharāṇāmagreṣu viśrāntaṃ
vasudhāmaṇḍalasyodaraṃ madhyaṃ yeṣām

udaragrahaṇādadhojambūdvīpaprānteṣveva dikṣu
madhyatanamaṇḍapastambhavaddiggajānāṃ bhūmidhāraṇe niveśa iti gamyate

ata
eva jambūdvīpabhuvaṃ khanadbhiḥ sagaraputraiḥ pratidiśaṃ diggajā dṛṣṭā iti
pūrvarāmāyaṇe'pyuktam

durgandha iti bhūtānāṃ nāraki prāṇināṃ ābhāḥ svakarmaikṛtāḥ pratibhāsā
yatra

kvacit adhastananārakapradeśamārabhya ābhūtalaṃ
uparitanāsmadīyabhūtalaparyantaṃ saptāpūpaprotalohaśalākāvat
protasaptapātālamaṇḍalaiḥ ratnānāmākarabhūtairmervādigiripādairvyāptaḥ

surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca śiraḥsu suptā iva viśrāntāḥ pādāmbhoruhapāṃsavo
yasya tathāvidhena

āsurībhirasurastrībhiḥ senābhirvā saṃbhṛtairanantairbahuvidhopakaraṇaiḥ
pūjanāni krīḍanāni ca eṣṭumabhilaṣituṃ śīlaṃ yasya tathāvidhena hāṭakeśena
svarṇaliṅgātmanā purāṇeṣu prasiddhena śivena

trailokyalakṣaṇānāṃ
ratnānāṃ kośa iva svodare rakṣitā

kekayā
mayūravāaṇyā ahīnāṃ hṛnnāḍyo hṛdayaśirā iva śoṣaṃ jagmurārtatāṃ
bhayasvinnatāṃ cājagmuḥ

kupitākṛteryasya pratāpasya ugrairduḥsahairūṣmabhiruṣṇasparśaiḥ sapta
mahābdhayaḥ śoṣonmukhāḥ santaḥ kalpakāla iva gartasaṃkhyāmātreṇa saptatāṃ
yayurna jalādipūrasaṃkhyayetyarthaḥ

dṛṣṭyā dṛḍhāghātastiryakprekṣaṇaṃ tena nunnā bhūmyādhārakulācalā
yāsāṃ tathāvidhā diśaḥ

līlayā vijitā aśeṣāṇāṃ bhuvanābhogānāṃ lokasaṃsthānāṃ bhūṣaṇabhūtā
indrādayo yena

trailokye'pyudāravṛttiṣūtkṛṣṭasthitiṣu bhogeṣu bhukteṣu satsu viṣayabhūteṣu ca
udvegaṃ vairasyamabhajat

meruśṛṅgasya śikhāyāmagrabhāge ratnakṛtaharmyavātāyane sthita
upaviṣṭaḥ san
na kṣuṇṇā parairakuṇṭhitā śaktiryasya athāvidhena mayā
ato mahatāṃ puro lāmpaṭyaṃ lajjāyai natu tuṣṭaye

prājñasya dṛśyā iyaṃ viḍambanā punaḥpunaḥ
kṛtānukaraṇamivopahāsaheturityarthaḥ
yena labdhena punaḥ karma na vidyate kṛtakṛtyatā syāttādṛśo'rthaḥ kaḥ syāt

vastutaḥ paramārthato
vastuśūnyaiva iyaṃ śiśukrīḍā anarthaprasaro
duḥkhaparamparāprāptistadarthibhiḥ kriyate

yasminprāpte sati itaranna kiṃcana kārya kartavyamasti tādṛśaṃ phalaṃ
puruṣārthamiha na kiṃcana paśyāmi

kimuvāca
tadāha - saṃsmṛtaṃ samyaṅmayā smṛtamiti smṛtārthaṃ manasyeva
vimarśayanvimṛśan

sakaladuḥkhānāṃ sāṃsārikasukhānāṃ ca parihāraprāpnyupāyagocarāḥ sarve
vyavahārabhramā yatra śāntā asau saṃsārasīmno'nto'vadhiḥ kaḥ ucyate
prājñairityarthaḥ
